'''Lianna''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Propaganda">''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''</ref> located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route]]<ref name="TFABG" /> in the [[Lianna system]] in the [[Allied Tion sector]],<ref name="Appendix" /> in the [[Tion Cluster]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TFABG" /> that was home to the powerful [[Santhe family]].<ref name="Propaganda" />
